_about: The fleet's public, non-secret identifiers, read through tools/fleet_ids.py. Generated from the operator's private registry, which holds these and the identifiers that are not public: change a value there and regenerate, never here. Only identifiers already published in public files are copied.

github_owner.what: the GitHub account that owns every fleet repository

cerberus_app_id.what: GitHub App ID of Cerberus-AZ, the fleet's PR reviewer

pr_sentinel_app_id.what: GitHub App ID of pr-sentinel, which posts the pr-sentinel / issue-reference check

cloudflare_fleet_account_id.what: CloudFlare account the fleet's Workers and sites deploy to
